# GetClassUsage

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.1" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `GetClassUsageInspection`

Since PHP 7.2, passing `null` to `get_class()` is an error-level misuse (it no
longer silently falls back to the calling class). This rule flags
`get_class(x)` calls whose single argument may be `null` and that are not
preceded by any null check of that same expression in the enclosing function.

## Example

Language level 7.4:

```php{4,5,6,24,29}
<?php

function describe($entity = null, $label = 'x', ?Order $order = null, Invoice $invoice = NULL) {
    \get_class(NULL);
    get_class($entity);
    get_class($order);

    get_class($label);
    get_class($entity, 1);

    if (empty($invoice)) {
        return;
    }
    get_class($invoice);

    while ($order instanceof Order) {
        get_class($order);
    }
}

function report(?Order $first, ?Order $second) {
    $tag = $first ? 'a' : 'b';
    echo get_class($first);
    echo get_class($second);
    if (null != $second) {}
}

$loose = null;
get_class($loose);
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: get_class() rejects null on PHP 7.2+; guard the argument.</li>
<li>line 5: get_class() rejects null on PHP 7.2+; guard the argument.</li>
<li>line 6: get_class() rejects null on PHP 7.2+; guard the argument.</li>
<li>line 24: get_class() rejects null on PHP 7.2+; guard the argument.</li>
<li>line 29: get_class() rejects null on PHP 7.2+; guard the argument.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "GetClassUsage": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore GetClassUsage

/**
 * @noinspection GetClassUsageInspection
 */
```
